feedback: Add a separate EQ-5D-5L InstrumentUse with context DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and function HEALTH_STATE_DESCRIPTION. The source states that the descriptive system defines the hypothetical health states; VALUATION_TARGET alone does not represent this role. For sw1, sw2, and sw3, do not use MODEL_IMPLEMENTATION for the construction of the experimental designs. Keep the exact software identities and add a linked UNMAPPED_VALUE Gap for software_function. State that Ngene, SAS macros, and R implemented DCE experimental-design construction algorithms. Keep sw5 as the separate R use for quantitative analysis.

Add the source-study administration evidence. Create an InstrumentUse for EQ-5D with context SOURCE_STUDY_ACTIVITY and function OUTCOME_MEASURE, and link administration records for the reported source-study modes. Add a finding that face-to-face interviews were most frequent (44 of 187 studies; 23.5%) and digital administration was next (43 of 187; 23.0%). For the pooled subgroup values in f4 and f5, replace each null denominator with 'studies in the stated subgroup; exact number not reported in the supplied article text' and add NOT_REPORTED Gaps for the exact subgroup study counts. Add a DataUse for the published general-population EQ-5D norms used for the contextual comparison in i1, with origin DOCUMENTARY_SOURCE and level AGGREGATE_ESTIMATE; clarify that the review did not conduct a pooled head-to-head comparison with a general-population control group. Add an UNMODELED_ASPECT Gap stating that the review protocol was not registered because the authors did not aim to estimate treatment effects.

Retain the Study, family, purposes, status, and main design. Add a second planned EQ-5D-5L InstrumentUse with function SCORING_INPUT, and link ScoringUse sc1 to it; retain iu1 as the OUTCOME_MEASURE use. Change iu2 (Fagerstrom test) and iu3 (Alcohol Use Disorder Identification Test) to PREDICTOR_MEASURE because the empirical analysis uses health behaviours as covariates. Split du2 into separate household-questionnaire and individual-questionnaire DataUses because Table 2 identifies different respondents and data sources. Add the household questionnaire as a planned QUANTITATIVE_DATA_COLLECTION MethodUse with an Administration for the household head/main respondent. Revise adm1 so its EQ-5D-5L local-language statement applies only to iu1 and the new scoring-input use; use a separate Administration for the other individual instruments, for which the source does not report instrument languages.

Change s1.execution_state from DATA_COLLECTION_COMPLETE to COMPLETED because collection, analysis, and reporting were complete. Clarify that s1 is the post hoc methodological analysis and lessons report, not a prospectively designed personal-versus-tele-TTO project: change its label to "Post hoc methodological comparison and lessons from personal and tele-TTO interviews." For du1–du4, change origin from CURRENT_STUDY_COLLECTION to PRIOR_RESEARCH_COLLECTION because the article states that the underlying project was designed to replicate and extend Lipman et al., that the collected data types were fixed before the mode change, and that the project was not designed to compare the two modes. Keep l1 and l2. Revise f7 to distinguish evidence from inference: state that the interviewer subjectively recalled more no-shows, scheduling flexibility, technical problems, and greater demands; state separately that reduced visual cues and difficulty with rapport were proposed explanations or concerns, because rapport and respondent experience were not measured. The remaining family, purpose, methods, instruments, results, limitations, and recorded source conflict can remain unchanged.

Add HEALTH_STATE_VALUATION as the second-ranked Purpose because the current study directly elicits preferences for hypothetical health states. Change comparison_structure from NONCOMPARATIVE to BETWEEN_METHOD because the planned integration compares quantitative indicators with qualitative findings. Record that the design gives greater priority to the qualitative component (QUAL+quan), for example as a source-faithful Concept linked to the study and both parts. Rename part2 as the qualitative focus-group component. Clear the part links from du5, mu6, and a7 because the field-note observations span questionnaire completion and focus-group discussion, rather than only the qualitative part.

Remove des6. The source reports a systematic review with categorical descriptive analysis, but it does not report narrative synthesis. Change du2 data level from DOCUMENT to AGGREGATE_ESTIMATE because the extracted HSU values are summary estimates. Create a separate Population for base-case HSU values and link sam5 to it; sam5 must not use the publication-eligibility population. Add the principal finding that CUA publication numbers increased significantly, especially after 2013. Add the reported finding that 20 HSUs, or 0.5% of all HSUs, used an unjustifiable estimation method. Add a SourceConflict for the abstract statement that characteristics were unreported in more than 80% of studies versus the main analysis, which reports HSU-level nonreporting of 65.4%, 76.9%, 84.3%, and 91.0%.
